verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy is a fair axis for a hosted auth API, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions API versioning, version pinning, or deprecation timelines. The OpenAPI spec probe shows a machine-readable API description exists, but that is an adjacent feature and says nothing about versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
